 Mung beans recalled after glass fragments found in product
 By Daniel Miller FOX Local Recalls Published  October 27, 2026 2:27 PM EDT Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Published  October 27, 2026 2:27 PM EDT article Natural Grocers Brand Organic 2-Pound Mung Beans were recalled due to the potential presence of glass. (Photo courtesy of the Food and Drug Administration)  
 The Brief
 Natural Grocers Brand Bulk Organic Mung Beans were recalled after a customer complained about finding glass fragments. 
 The beans reportedly were shipped to multiple states, including Arkansas, Colorado, Iowa, and Texas. 
 Consumers who purchased the beans should stop using the product and return it to the store to receive a refund. 
 A brand of mung beans was recalled over the possible presence of glass.
 Vitamin Cottage Natural Food Markets, Inc.   pulled the beans from store shelves after a customer complained about finding sharp glass fragments in the product. 
 RELATED:   Sugar recall: 1.7 million pounds recalled over possible allergens 
 Food and Drug Administration officials said there were no illnesses or injuries reported to date related to the item. 
 Mung beans recalled 
 Local perspective:
 Natural Grocers Brand Bulk Organic Mung Beans   were recalled, and the product is packaged in 2-pound clear plastic bags.
 According to the Food and Drug Administration, the affected lots of the beans may have been distributed to Natural Grocers store locations in the following states: 
 Arkansas 
 Arizona 
 Colorado 
 Iowa 
 Idaho 
 Kansas 
 Louisiana 
 Minnesota 
 Missouri 
 Montana 
 North Dakota 
 Nebraska 
 New Mexico 
 Nevada 
 Oklahoma 
 Oregon 
 South Dakota 
 Texas 
 Utah 
 Washington State 
 Wisconsin 
 Wyoming 
 Can I get a refund if I purchased the mung beans?
 What you can do:
 Food and Drug Administration officials said that consumers who bought mung beans should stop using it immediately and either throw them away or return them to the place where they were purchased to receive a full refund or credit.
 Anyone with questions about the recall can contact Vitamin Cottage Natural Food Markets, Inc. at 303-226-1434, Monday-Friday, 8am-5 pm (mountain time), or email  media@naturalgrocers.com .
 The Source: Information for this story was provided by a Food and Drug Administration recall notice. This story was reported from Washington, D.C.
